objectives:
Students will learn to communicate points that are unique to their own culture/country and discuss differences with others. Students will learn about how these differences influence styles of communication.
Communication skills will be improved through listening, speaking, reading, and writing. Students will watch videos depicting various scenes in the global community, to deepen their understanding not only about language, but also about cultures and mutual understanding.

[Target]
To gain confidence in communicating as a member of the global community.
overview:
In each class, students will have an opportunity to introduce an article of their choice and point out interests for further discussion.
Through these discussions, students will learn grammar, vocabulary, idioms, and other forms of speech as they come naturally. During the term, students will be asked to give periodic presentations. The final test will be a presentation followed by a listening test.
grading_criteria:
(i) Active class participation(asking questions, eliciting answers, class preparation) 
(ii) Eye contact and expression
(iii) Content and vocabulary usage
(iv) Clarity and grammar
teacher_message:
The most important thing about learning to communicate in a different language is to be interested and enjoy. Teaching others about your own culture is also fun and a learning experience for you, too. It will open your eyes to other cultures as well.
Some of the class content below is subject to change, depending on specific class interests and needs.
【Preparation & Review】
The teacher will give you instructions every class, for the next class.
As there is no textbook for this class, you are expected to keep a notebook or have your notes organized in your computer or tablet.
